# 1. Repeatable (10-year cooldown): Line-Theme Live-Fire Drills (Act 2+, also restores oe_bem_mil_reformed if degraded).
oe_bem_dec_line_theme_drills = {
    decision_category = country_specific_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_bem_is_host = yes
        OR = {
            current_year >= 1648
            has_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed
            has_global_variable = oe_bem_test_mode
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 140
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_bem_drills_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_bem_dec_line_theme_drills.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -140
            set_variable = { name = oe_bem_drills_cd months = 120 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bem_dec_drills_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_bem_mil_reformed value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_mil_reformed value = 1 }
            }
            oe_bem_push_inst = { inst = military_revolution val = 10 }
        }
    }
}
